ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade triage app providing rPPG contactless heart-rate sensing and multi-lingual triage for rural health workers in India.
ideas.problem_statement: Healthcare access gaps in rural and semi-urban regions across India requiring rapid initial health assessment.
ideas.title: MediScan Rural Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines high-impact social utility with a working computer-vision demo (rPPG), echoing successful health-tech hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: An alternative credit-scoring and risk mitigation platform for micro-agri-lenders using graph intelligence and explainable machine learning.
ideas.problem_statement: FinTech and financial inclusion barriers for small-scale farmers and rural enterprises lacking formal credit histories.
ideas.title: AgriGraph AML & Credit Risk
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a massive economic problem in India's rural sector using sophisticated graph intelligence and explainable AI scoring.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered carbon tracking and optimized logistics routing dashboard for university and corporate campus supply chains.
ideas.problem_statement: Inefficient delivery logistics and high carbon footprints within large institutional campuses across India.
ideas.title: EcoRoute Campus Logistics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets Sustainability and Logistics domains simultaneously while providing clear, quantifiable carbon-reduction metrics.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent personalized tutoring platform utilizing RAG to bridge learning gaps for engineering and vocational students in India.
ideas.problem_statement: High student-to-faculty ratios in Indian universities leaving individual learning gaps unaddressed.
ideas.title: EduMentor Agent Studio
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages advanced multi-agent orchestrations and RAG architectures that consistently score top spots in educational hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven community reporting platform that aggregates local infrastructural issues and automatically drafts actionable reports for municipal authorities.
ideas.problem_statement: Inefficient channels for citizens to report hyper-local civic issues and track resolution progress.
ideas.title: CivicPulse Local Impact Copilot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines civic tech with an AI copilot, creating a tangible product with immediate real-world deployment potential.
